capabilities: Two-way sync the vault with Alipan across devices
Transfer only changed files via incremental sync
Browse and manage remote cloud files in a visual explorer
Resolve conflicts with character-level merging or newest-timestamp rules
Skip oversized files and enable a loose sync mode for vaults with thousands of notes
extras: README is bilingual (Chinese with English glosses); it warns that the first sync is slow for large vaults and advises backing up before syncing.
intentEvidence: 本项目 fork 自 Obsidian Nutstore Sync（坚果云 / Nutstore），将其 WebDAV 后端替换为阿里云盘开放 API
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault through Alipan, so users of that cloud drive lack a native sync path.

relations.evidence: 本项目 fork 自 Obsidian Nutstore Sync（坚果云 / Nutstore），将其 WebDAV 后端替换为阿里云盘开放 API

summary: Two-way sync plugin that keeps an Obsidian vault in sync with Alipan (Alibaba Cloud Drive) across devices.
